globalDir.faqSubheading: Find answers about the CNESS directory, certification visibility, trust profiles, and organization recognition.
globalDir.ctaSubtext: Start taking intentional steps toward becoming more conscious, purposeful, and impactful.
globalDir.faqCertA1: CNESS Certification recognizes who your organization is, what it stands for, and how it creates value across six key pillars. It provides a structured pathway to strengthen credibility, amplify growth, and become recognized as a Global Conscious Organization.
globalDir.faqCertA2: The process is simple. Create your organization profile, complete the required certification steps, and submit your information for evaluation. Through the process of assessing your organization, you also strengthen your practices, build your brand, and advance your organizational growth.
globalDir.faqCertQ3: Will my existing certifications affect my eligibility?
globalDir.faqCertA3: No. Existing certifications do not affect your eligibility for CNESS Certification. They can complement the CNESS framework, add value to your organization's profile, and contribute positively to its overall recognition.
globalDir.faqGeneralA1: CNESS is a global Consciousness Ecosystem that connects and recognizes Global Conscious Organizations. It helps organizations:  • Build credibility and trust • Strengthen global visibility • Demonstrate conscious business practices • Connect with aligned organizations and stakeholders • Create long-term value and measurable impact
globalDir.faqGeneralA2: CNESSWORKS is the digital platform where organizations begin their certification journey, create their Trust Profile, and become visible in the Global Directory. It brings certification, recognition, visibility, and access to a global ecosystem together in one platform.
globalDir.faqGeneralA3: CNESSWORKS is designed for businesses, institutions, startups, service providers, and organizations of every size. Organizations seeking to become recognized conscious organizations can use the platform to strengthen trust, improve credibility, and showcase their impact.
globalDir.faqDirA1: The CNESSWORKS Global Directory is where organizations showcase their conscious profile, credibility, certification status, and Consciousness Impact Score. Being listed connects your organization to the global community of Global Conscious Organizations (GCO).
globalDir.faqDirQ2: Why should my organization be listed in the Global Directory?
globalDir.faqDirA2: The Global Directory features organizations recognized for their dependability and conscious practices across the six CNESS pillars. A listing helps your organization:  • Build greater credibility and visibility • Connect with the global conscious business community • Reach new customers across international markets • Serve conscious customers around the world • Attract aligned professionals and strengthen talent acquisition • Enhance brand promotion, discoverability, and business opportunities
globalDir.faqDirQ3: Do I need to be certified to appear in the Global Directory?
globalDir.faqDirA3: Organizations may appear in the Global Directory before completing certification. However, certification unlocks greater credibility, enhanced visibility, access to the Consciousness Impact Score, and recognition as a Global Conscious Organization.
globalDir.faqPartnerQ1: What is the CNESSWORKS Partner Program?
globalDir.faqPartnerA1: The CNESSWORKS Partner Program enables individuals, organizations, institutions, and platforms to support conscious business growth through referrals, media, implementation, and strategic collaboration. It empowers partners to become a meaningful part of the positive change they wish to see in the world.
globalDir.faqPartnerQ2: Who can become a CNESSWORKS Partner?
globalDir.faqPartnerA2: Conscious pioneers, prominent individuals, consultants, advisors, media platforms, institutions, service providers, and organizations creating meaningful impact can apply. The program is designed for those who can introduce, support, promote, or guide organizations within the CNESSWORKS ecosystem.
globalDir.faqPartnerQ3: How can I become a partner?
globalDir.faqPartnerA3: Becoming a partner is a simple process. Select the pathway that best matches your expertise, network, and goals, submit your application, and the CNESSWORKS team will review it and guide you through the next steps.

listed.name: Yodley
listed.description: We believe that food should be as nature intended—pure, wholesome, and full of nourishment. Yodley's journey began with a simple vision: chemical-free, preservative-free and minimally processed food straight from the farm to your plate. The brand works directly with farmers, fosters fair trade practices and creates meaningful rural employment by eliminating unnecessary middlemen. The result is a transparent farm-to-fork supply chain that keeps quality high while empowering the people who grow the food.

listed.name: FrigoScan
listed.description: FrigoScan Post Harvest Technologies is a specialised agri and food processing solution provider delivering turnkey solutions across cold chain, food processing, and agri infrastructure. With decades of hands-on industry experience, FrigoScan supports businesses in translating concepts into operational, compliant, and scalable food ventures. Our role spans planning, technology selection, execution support, and market readiness. FrigoScan has supported agri and food projects across India, with strong global exposure through overseas principals, international technology partners, and export-oriented market linkages. Our solutions align with global food safety and quality standards, while remaining practical and cost-effective for emerging and growing markets. Mr.Sankaran is a socio food preneur spanning over three decades of experience with inovative expertise in creating sustainable, viable food businesses across the globe. Connecting rural agriculture to responsible food globally has been the prime objective behind these initiatives. His revolutionary concepts in areas like covering post harvest management, cold chain and food processing have contributed significantly to India’s Footprint in Agri business. His work contributed to signature agri processing projects across India like Maagrita (Tamil Nadu), Galla Foods (Andhra Pradesh), and many Mega Food Parks across the country. Apart from these his contribution in creating value supply chain in the food processing segment is commendable. He has played a pivotal role in establishing many socio- economic projects covering the entire spectrum from agriculture to plate emphasizing the importance of women power in such areas. Connecting the global markets across Asia pacific, Europe and USA for value added Indian agri products has been the main stay of his expertise.

listed.name: India Builders
listed.description: India Builders (Chennai) Limited is a trusted residential property developer founded in 1987 by civil engineers Mr. J. Uttam Kumar and Mr. C. Thambikalaignan. From a single project a year, the firm grew into a multi-project developer and was later incorporated as a limited company (CIN U45202TN2005PLC056088, registered 2005). As an ISO 9001 organisation, India Builders follows structured international quality standards across design, construction and handover. The group has served over 2,500 customers and delivered more than 3 million sq.ft of apartments, flats and living spaces across Chennai and Coimbatore. A sister concern, Sabari Constructions and Housing Private Limited, operates from the same premises with shared directors. Corporate office: AA-36, 3rd Main Road, 3rd Street, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600040. Coimbatore office: 15/9, RK Nagar, Bharathi Park 4th Cross, Sai Baba Colony, Coimbatore 641011. listed.name: Horizon Foods Group
listed.description: Horizon Foods Group makes the everyday food that fills Indian kitchens: atta, rice, pulses, spice mixes and a growing range of ready-to-cook curries, batters and frozen parathas. We run two manufacturing plants in Chakan and Satara, a temperature-controlled distribution hub in Bhiwandi, and a fleet of 64 refrigerated trucks that supply about 38,000 retail outlets across western and central India. About 1,200 people work with us, roughly two thirds of them on plant floors and in warehouses. We buy pulses and wheat directly from farmer producer organizations in Marathwada and Vidarbha, which gives us traceability to the village level for most of our staples. Our ready-to-cook line is built for families with less time but the same expectations of home-style food, so we keep ingredient lists short and avoid artificial colors. We publish our food safety audit summaries every year and treat complaints as data, not noise.

Today, with seven offices strategically located in global maritime hubs, Nautilus Shipping delivers tailored solutions that keep your fleet running smoothly and efficiently. To be the trusted link between shipowners and seafarers by providing dependable, high-quality maritime services that meet evolving industry standards. listed.name: Apollo Hospitals
listed.description: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited is an Indian multinational healthcare group headquartered in Chennai. It is the second largest for-profit private hospital network in India after Manipal Hospitals, with a network of 71 owned and managed hospitals. Along with the eponymous hospital chain, the company also operates pharmacies, primary care and diagnostic centres, telehealth clinics, and digital healthcare services among others through its subsidiaries. The company was founded by Prathap C. Reddy in 1983 as the first corporate healthcare provider in India. Several of Apollo's hospitals have been among the first in India to receive international healthcare accreditation by the United States based Joint Commission International (JCI) as well as NABH accreditation. Apollo Hospitals and its subsidiaries have faced multiple allegations of overcharging, forceful transplants, and corruption.

listed.name: cnessworks
listed.description: CNESSWORKS connects conscious organizations, trusted standards, proven best practices, verified businesses, products, services, and opportunities in one global ecosystem - making it it easier to discover, learn, verify, connect, and grow with purpose and credibility. Assisting & recognizing conscious organizations as reliable and dependable businesses creating impact for a greater humanity. A product is not conscious in the human sense. Yet every decision embedded within it can reflect awareness, responsibility, dignity, transparency and long-term care. Every material selected, person involved, process controlled, claim communicated, customer supported and impact created reveals something about the consciousness behind the product. CNESS Conscious Product Certification examines whether responsible intent has become visible through credible practices, appropriate evidence, trustworthy outcomes and a commitment to improvement.

listed.name: google
listed.description: Google (officially known as Google LLC) ( , GOO-gəl) is an American multinational technology corporation focused on information technology, online advertising, search engine technology, email, cloud computing, software, quantum computing, e-commerce, consumer electronics, and artificial intelligence (AI). It has been referred to as "the most powerful company in the world" by the BBC, and is one of the world's most valuable brands. Google's parent company, Alphabet Inc., has been described as a Big Tech company. Google was founded in 1998 by American computer scientists Larry Page and Sergey Brin. Together, they own about 14% of its publicly listed shares and control 56% of its stockholder voting power through super-voting stock. The company went public via an initial public offering (IPO) in 2004. In 2015, Google was reorganized as a wholly owned subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. Google is Alphabet's largest subsidiary and is a holding company for Alphabet's internet properties and interests. Sundar Pichai was appointed CEO of Google in 2015, replacing Larry Page, who became the CEO of Alphabet. In 2019, Pichai also became the CEO of Alphabet. After the success of its original service, Google Search (often known simply as "Google"), the company has rapidly grown to offer a multitude of products and services. These products address a wide range of use cases, including email (Gmail), navigation and mapping (Waze, Maps, and Earth), cloud computing (Cloud), web navigation (Chrome), video sharing (YouTube), productivity (Workspace), operating systems (Android and ChromeOS), cloud storage (Drive), language translation (Translate), photo storage (Photos), videotelephony (Meet), smart home (Nest), smartphones (Pixel), wearable technology (Pixel Watch and Fitbit), music streaming (YouTube Music), video on demand (YouTube TV), AI (Gemini), machine learning APIs (TensorFlow), AI chips (TPU), and more.

It introduced Ramco Hilux calcium silicate boards using technology from A&A Corporation, Japan. At its Golden Jubilee the company took up the vision “Pioneering Green Dry Construction”.
